butter in a large pan until crisp and golden on both sides.Pile onto a platter, top with the onions and serve with sour cream and chives.Bleacher honey chilli roasted peanutsRoasted peanuts coated in honey, butter and chilli flakesHow to make it30g butter3 tbsp honey2 tbsp brown sugar400g raw unsalted peanuts1/2 tsp chilli flakes1 tsp sea salt flakesMelt the butter with the honey and brown sugar, then toss the peanuts and chilli flakes through until coated.Spread on a lined tray and bake at 170°C, stirring every few minutes, until deep golden.Sprinkle with sea salt while hot, then cool kielbasa sausages4 long soft rolls150ml smoky barbecue sauceBake the chips at 220°C until crisp.Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar for the slaw.Score the kielbasa and grill, turning, until charred.Split the rolls, lay a kielbasa in each, pile on hot chips, drizzle with barbecue sauce and top with slaw.SweetsWild Thing lattice cherry pieCherry pie with a woven vanilla ice cream, to serveDrain the cherries, keeping some of the juice. Simmer the juice with the sugar and cornflour until thick, then stir in the cherries and a squeeze of lemon.Line a 23cm pie dish with one pastry sheet and fill with the cherries.Cut the other sheets into strips and weave a lattice over the top.
